Cava-Cava.name: Cava Cava
Cava-Cava.summary: Cava cava is a 2D arcade game developed and published by Tectoy, released exclusively as a built-in memory title for Brazilian Master System hardware models.

Comical Machine Gun Joe.name: Comical Machine Gun Joe
Comical Machine Gun Joe.summary: This game was originally released only in Japan on Sega Card, though has appeared in several compilations since.
